title: Fully Leased Office Building
summary: Single-story office building on Gaines School Road between Cedar Shoals Road and Lexington Road (US 78), fully leased to a long-term credit tenant. Two curb cuts give easy access in and out, and Kroger- and Publix-anchored shopping, Highway 78 and Athens Ben Epps Airport are all close by.
highlights: Fully leased to a long-term credit tenant
Two curb-cut entrances on Gaines School Road
Under a mile from Kroger- and Publix-anchored retail
alt: Fully leased office building at 745 Gaines School Road, Athens, Georgia
